b2-peruandino-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Worries Scientists
b2-peruandino-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the glaciers of the Cordillera Blanca, and he asks what the scientists worry about.
b2-peruandino-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what worries the scientists most, putting that idea in the spotlight.
cues: Say that it is the melting
b2-peruandino-01.target: Lo que más preocupa a los científicos es el deshielo.
b2-peruandino-01.english: What worries the scientists most is the melting.
b2-peruandino-01.canDo: I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*Lo que..., Fue en... cuando...*).

b2-peruandino-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Incas
b2-peruandino-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading an article about Caral, and she asks what existed before the Incas.
b2-peruandino-02.prompt: Tell Meg that before the Incas came, there were already cities in the Andes.
b2-peruandino-02.target: Antes de que llegaran los incas, ya había ciudades en los Andes.
b2-peruandino-02.english: Before the Incas arrived, there were already cities in the Andes.
b2-peruandino-02.canDo: I can order events with *antes de que* and *después de que* and the right mood.

b2-peruandino-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Quipus in the Empire
b2-peruandino-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading about the Inca empire for a short talk, and he asks how numbers were recorded.
b2-peruandino-03.prompt: Tell Carlos how numbers were recorded in the Inca empire, using the passive with se.
cues: Say what it was used for
b2-peruandino-03.target: En el imperio inca se usaban quipus para anotar números.
b2-peruandino-03.english: In the Inca empire quipus were used to record numbers.
b2-peruandino-03.canDo: I can say what was built, used or kept with the passive *se* (*se construyeron*, *se usaban*).

b2-peruandino-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Names Barely Known
b2-peruandino-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are visiting a talk about the Cusco School of painting, and she asks about the painters.
b2-peruandino-04.prompt: Tell Meg, with your own regret, that the names of many painters are barely known.
cues: Show how you feel about it
Say that the names are barely known
b2-peruandino-04.target: Lamentablemente, de muchos pintores apenas se conoce el nombre.
b2-peruandino-04.english: Unfortunately, the name of many painters is barely known.
b2-peruandino-04.canDo: I can show my attitude to a fact with stance adverbs (*lamentablemente*, *en rigor*, *precisamente*, *apenas*).

b2-peruandino-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Linguists Say
b2-peruandino-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading an article about Quechua, and he asks what the linguists say about young speakers.
b2-peruandino-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what several linguists point out about young speakers of Quechua in the cities.
cues: Say that young speakers are being lost
b2-peruandino-05.target: Varios lingüistas señalan que el quechua pierde hablantes jóvenes en las ciudades.
b2-peruandino-05.english: Several linguists point out that Quechua is losing young speakers in the cities.
b2-peruandino-05.canDo: I can report what experts and speakers say with reporting verbs (*señalar*, *afirmar*, *recordar*, *negar*).

b2-peruandino-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Andes in Review
b2-peruandino-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a short talk about the Peruvian Andes, and she asks what road network the Incas built.
b2-peruandino-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg which road network the Incas built, putting the idea in the spotlight.
b2-peruandino-consolidation.target: Lo que construyeron los incas fue el Qhapaq Ñan.
b2-peruandino-consolidation.english: What the Incas built was the Qhapaq Ñan.
b2-peruandino-consolidation.canDo: I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*Lo que..., Fue en... cuando...*).
